description: This file defines the interface 'SavingsAccountTransactionSearchService' for searching savings account transactions within the Fineract project. It includes method declarations for searching transactions with standard search parameters and for executing advanced query searches.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionSearchService
classes.description: Interface defining search operations for savings account transactions, including basic search and advanced querying.

methods.name: searchTransactions
methods.description: Searches for transactions associated with a specific savings account based on provided search parameters.

methods.name: queryAdvanced
methods.description: Performs an advanced, potentially complex query to retrieve savings account transactions based on an 'AdvancedQueryRequest'.
